options.D: Positioning with the joint above the stump in extension

questions.explanation: Keeping hips and knee extended prevents flexion contracture.
questions.sourceBook: Original question prepared for this simulator from standard textbook knowledge

questions.question: Anaemia in chronic kidney disease is mainly due to deficiency of:
questions.explanation: The failing kidney cannot produce enough erythropoietin.

questions.question: Pump handle movement of the ribs primarily occurs at the:
questions.explanation: Upper ribs (2-6) move up and forward like a pump handle, increasing the anteroposterior diameter.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: In myositis ossificans traumatica at elbow:

options.A: Forced passive mobilization should not be given
options.B: Forced passive mobilization should be given
options.C: Forced passive mobilization should be given after application of IFT
options.D: Forced passive mobilization should not be given under GA

questions.explanation: Forced passive mobilisation aggravates bleeding and ossification and must be avoided.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
